newsitem.title: NORWAY: Saga restart of Vigdis oil delayed.
newsitem.headline: Saga restart of Vigdis oil delayed.

text.p: Saga Petroleum ASA said on Thursday the restart of the North Sea Vigdis oilfield had been delayed but it still hoped to resume crude production some time this week.
Saga said earlier on Thursday it had "begun the process of restarting" Vigdis.
"We still haven't started up yet and now we have to open a seal box and check a gasket. There are some indications of a leakage," Saga spokesman Bjoern Schibevaag told Reuters.
He said the work would take some hours.
"But we hope to have Vigdis up and going this week," Schibevaag said.
The development was closed down on May 23 after a gas leak was detected in the compressor train, which was traced back to a design fault. It was originally expected to restart at the end of June.
